description:
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Doubling Cube to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Doubling Cube.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Doubling Cube.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling your unspent mana.
Repeat from step 4.
